```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(ggrepel)
library(car)
library(GGally)
```


# Preparation

```{r}
bias_raw <- readr::read_csv(here("Dataset", "bias_WS_Ref_TotalVocab_2026Jul15.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
feat_raw <- readr::read_csv(here("Dataset", "LinguisticFeatures.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

bias <- bias_raw %>% mutate(
  language = str_squish(language),
  form     = str_squish(form),
  lexical_class = str_squish(lexical_class),
  measure  = str_squish(measure))
feat <- feat_raw %>% mutate(language = str_squish(language))

langs_in_feat <- feat %>% distinct(language, Family2, predicativeAdj)

bias_ws <- bias %>% filter(form == "WS") %>%
  inner_join(langs_in_feat, by = "language") %>% 
  subset(lexical_class != "Function Words")

# Check
bias_ws %>% count(lexical_class, measure) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

bias_ws %>% count(language, lexical_class) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```


```{r}
cult_raw <- readr::read_csv(here("Dataset", "CulturalFeatures.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

cult_num <- cult_raw %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("WS", "Seq")))

cult_vars <- c("individualism", "flexibility", "individualism_new", "distUS", "distChina", "relmob")

# Missing data
cult_raw %>% summarise(across(all_of(cult_vars), list(N = ~ sum(!is.na(.)), missing = ~ sum(is.na(.))))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", ".value"), names_pattern = "(.+)_(N|missing)$") %>%
  mutate(missing_pct = missing / nrow(cult_raw) * 100)


# Correlations among predictors
GGally::ggpairs(cult_num,
  lower = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("smooth_lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.3)),
  upper = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("cor", size = 3)),
  diag  = list(continuous = "densityDiag")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

cor_summary <- combn(cult_vars, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  map_dfr(\(vars) {
    dat <- cult_raw %>% select(all_of(vars)) %>% drop_na()
    test <- cor.test(dat[[1]], dat[[2]], method = "pearson")
    tibble(var1 = vars[1], var2 = vars[2], N = nrow(dat), r = unname(test$estimate), p = test$p.value)
  })
cor_summary %>% mutate(r = round(r, 2), p = case_when(p < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)))
```


```{r}
# --- join ---
df_all <- bias_ws %>% left_join(cult_raw, by = "language") %>% 
  mutate(lexical_class=factor(lexical_class, levels=c("Nouns", "Verbs", "Adjectives")))

g1_vars <- c("individualism", "flexibility")
g2_vars <- c("distUS", "distChina")
g3_vars <- c("individualism", "flexibility", "individualism_new", "relmob")

df_g1 <- df_all %>% select(language, lexical_class, mean, predicativeAdj, all_of(g1_vars))
df_g2 <- df_all %>% select(language, lexical_class, mean, predicativeAdj, all_of(g2_vars))
df_g3 <- df_all %>% select(language, lexical_class, mean, predicativeAdj, all_of(g3_vars))

to_long <- function(df, vars){
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars), names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(mean))
}


# Group 1
df_g1_long <- to_long(df_g1, g1_vars)

ggplot(df_g1_long, aes(x = value, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(lexical_class ~ feature, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(x = "Cultural feature", y = "Lexical category bias")


# Group 2
df_g2_long <- to_long(df_g2, g2_vars)

ggplot(df_g2_long, aes(x = value, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(lexical_class ~ feature, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(x = "Cultural feature", y = "Lexical category bias")


# Group 3
df_g3_long <- to_long(df_g3, g3_vars)

ggplot(df_g3_long, aes(x = value, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(lexical_class ~ feature, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(x = "Cultural feature", y = "Lexical category bias")


# Correlations
bias_col <- "mean"   
cls_col  <- "lexical_class" 

cor_tbl <- function(df_long){
  df_long %>%
    group_by(.data[[cls_col]], feature) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(value) & !is.na(.data[[bias_col]])),
      r = suppressWarnings(cor(value, .data[[bias_col]], use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")),
      p = suppressWarnings(cor.test(value, .data[[bias_col]], method = "pearson")$p.value),
      .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(sig = case_when(p < .05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "n.s."))
}

cor_tbl(df_g1_long)
cor_tbl(df_g2_long)
cor_tbl(df_g3_long)
```



# Individualism vs. Collectivism

```{r}
dat_wide <- df_g1_long %>%
  select(language, lexical_class, bias = mean, predicativeAdj, feature, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(individualism, flexibility, bias) %>%
  mutate(
    individualism = as.numeric(scale(individualism)),
    flexibility   = as.numeric(scale(flexibility)))

dat_wide %>% select(-lexical_class, -bias) %>% distinct() %>% 
  summarize(r = cor(individualism, flexibility, use = "complete.obs"),
            p = cor.test(individualism, flexibility)$p.value,)

# == Noun bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism * flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))

tibble(model  = c("Interaction", "Main effect only"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Verb bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism * flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs"))

tibble(model  = c("Interaction", "Main effect only"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Adjective bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism * flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))

tibble(model  = c("Interaction", "Main effect only"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Adjective bias + verbal adjectives
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ predicativeAdj * (individualism + flexibility), data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ predicativeAdj + (individualism + flexibility), data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_3 <- lm(bias ~ (individualism + flexibility), data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))

tibble(
  model  = c("Interaction (pred Adj)", "Main effect (pred Adj)",  "No main effect (pred Adj)"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2), AIC(m_3)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2), BIC(m_3)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared, summary(m_3)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_3)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    deltaAdj_R2 = adj_R2 - max(adj_R2)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)

summary(m_3)
vif(m_3)

tmp <- df_g1_long %>% select(language, lexical_class, bias = mean, predicativeAdj, feature, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(individualism, flexibility, bias) 

write.csv(tmp, here("Results", "df_culture.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(dat_wide, here("Results", "df_culture_z.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
```


```{r}
df_g1_long2 <- df_g1_long %>%
  mutate(
    bias_type = dplyr::recode(lexical_class,
                       "Nouns" = "Noun bias",
                       "Verbs" = "Verb bias",
                       "Adjectives" = "Adjective bias"),
    bias_type = factor(bias_type, levels = c("Noun bias", "Verb bias", "Adjective bias")),
    feature = factor(
      feature,
      levels = c("individualism", "flexibility"),
      labels = c("Individualism vs.\nCollectivism", "Flexibility vs.\nMonumentalism")),
    language_group = case_when(
      str_detect(language, "^English") ~ "English",
      str_detect(language, "^Spanish") ~ "Spanish",
      str_detect(language, "^French") ~  "French",
      str_detect(language, "^Mandarin") ~ "Mandarin",
      TRUE ~ "Other"),
    region = str_match(language, "\\(([^)]+)\\)")[,2],
    region = if_else(is.na(region), language, region)) %>% 
  mutate(
    region_short = case_when(
      region == "American"    ~ "US",
      region == "Australian"  ~ "AUS",
      region == "British"     ~ "UK",
      region == "Irish"       ~ "IRL",
      region == "European"    ~ "EU",
      region == "Argentinian" ~ "ARG",
      region == "Mexican"     ~ "MEX",
      region == "Peruvian"    ~ "PER",
      region == "French"      ~ "FR",
      region == "Quebecois"   ~ "QC",
      region == "Beijing"     ~ "BJ",
      region == "Taiwanese"   ~ "TW",
      TRUE ~ region))


# Multiple regressions for visualization

tmp_noun <- tmp %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns")
m_noun <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = tmp_noun)

tmp_verb <- tmp %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs")
m_verb <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = tmp_verb)

tmp_adj <- tmp %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives")
m_adj <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = tmp_adj)

# summary(m_noun)
# summary(m_verb)
# summary(m_adj)

make_pred <- function(model, dat, focal, bias_type, n = 100) {
  # fix the other cultural predictor at its mean
  newdat <- tibble(individualism = mean(dat$individualism, na.rm = TRUE),
                   flexibility   = mean(dat$flexibility, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% slice(rep(1, n))
  
  # vary focal predictor
  newdat[[focal]] <- seq(min(dat[[focal]], na.rm = TRUE), max(dat[[focal]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n)
  
  pr <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, interval = "confidence")
  
  newdat %>%mutate(value = .data[[focal]],
                   fit = pr[, "fit"],
                   lwr = pr[, "lwr"],
                   upr = pr[, "upr"],
                   bias_type = bias_type,
                   feature = focal)
}

pred_cult <- bind_rows(
  make_pred(m_noun, tmp_noun, "individualism", "Noun bias"),
  make_pred(m_noun, tmp_noun, "flexibility",   "Noun bias"),
  make_pred(m_verb, tmp_verb, "individualism", "Verb bias"),
  make_pred(m_verb, tmp_verb, "flexibility",   "Verb bias"),
  make_pred(m_adj, tmp_adj, "individualism", "Adjective bias"),
  make_pred(m_adj, tmp_adj, "flexibility",   "Adjective bias")) %>%
  mutate(bias_type = factor(bias_type, levels = c("Noun bias", "Verb bias", "Adjective bias")),
         feature = factor(feature, levels = c("individualism", "flexibility"),
                          labels = c("Individualism vs.\nCollectivism", "Flexibility vs.\nMonumentalism")))
```


```{r}
df_other <- df_g1_long2
df_hi    <- df_g1_long2 %>% filter(language_group %in% c("English", "Spanish"))

col_cat <- c("Noun bias" = "#2C7BB6", "Verb bias" = "#1A9850", "Adjective bias" = "#D95F02")
col_hi <- c("English" = "#7B6DBA", "Spanish" = "#2A9D8F")


# single (separate) regression-based figure 

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_other, 
             aes(x = value, y = mean, color = bias_type), alpha = 0.15, size = 1.4) +
  geom_smooth(data = df_other, 
              aes(x = value, y = mean, color = bias_type), 
              method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, fill = "gray50", alpha = 0.12) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_cat, guide = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(data = df_hi, 
             aes(x = value, y = mean, color = language_group, shape = language_group), 
             alpha = 0.95, size = 2.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = df_hi, 
                           aes(x = value, y = mean, label = region_short), 
                           color = "grey25", size = 3.1, seed = 1, 
                           min.segment.length = 0, segment.color = "grey70", segment.alpha = 0.6, 
                           box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.20, force = 1.8, max.overlaps = Inf,
                           bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.12) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_hi, name = "Language group") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("English" = 16, "Spanish" = 17), name = "Language group") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = c(16, 17))), shape = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.75, color = "grey35") +
  facet_grid(bias_type ~ feature, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Lexical category bias") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box = "horizontal", 
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 6)),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(14, "pt"),
        legend.spacing.x  = unit(4, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = -2, r = 0, b = -2, l = 0),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey85"), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey87"), 
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="gray15", lineheight = 0.92, margin = margin(r = 1)), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color="gray15"), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color="gray15", margin = margin(t = 2)), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color="gray15", margin = margin(t = 2)), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "pt"), 
        panel.spacing.y = unit(5, "pt"), 
        plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))


# Multiple regressions for visualization

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_other, 
             aes(x = value, y = mean, color = bias_type), alpha = 0.15, size = 1.4) +
```

# Individualism (new) vs. Collectivism

```{r}
dat_wide <- df_g3_long %>%
  select(language, lexical_class, bias = mean, predicativeAdj, feature, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(individualism, flexibility, individualism_new, bias) %>%
  select(-relmob) %>% 
  mutate(
    individualism = as.numeric(scale(individualism)),
    flexibility   = as.numeric(scale(flexibility)),
    individualism_new = as.numeric(scale(individualism_new)))

dat_wide %>% distinct(language) %>% nrow()   # 28 languages remained

dat_wide %>% select(-lexical_class, -bias) %>% distinct() %>% 
  summarize(r_ind_indnew = cor(individualism_new, individualism, use = "complete.obs"),
            p_ind_indnew = cor.test(individualism_new, individualism)$p.value,
            r_flex_indnew = cor(individualism_new, flexibility, use = "complete.obs"),
            p_flex_indnew = cor.test(individualism_new, flexibility)$p.value)

# == Noun bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism_new + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))

tibble(model  = c("m_1 (individualism old)", "m_2 (individualism new)"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    deltaAdj_R2 = adj_R2 - max(adj_R2)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Verb bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism_new + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs"))

tibble(model  = c("m_1 (individualism old)", "m_2 (individualism new)"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    deltaAdj_R2 = adj_R2 - max(adj_R2)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Adjective bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism_new + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))

tibble(model  = c("m_1 (individualism old)", "m_2 (individualism new)"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    deltaAdj_R2 = adj_R2 - max(adj_R2)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)


# == Adjective bias + verbal adjectives
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism_new + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_3 <- lm(bias ~ predicativeAdj + (individualism + flexibility), data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
m_4 <- lm(bias ~ predicativeAdj + (individualism_new + flexibility), data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))

tibble(model  = c("m_1 (ind. old)", "m_2 (ind. new)", "m_3 (ind. old + pred Adj)", "m_4 (ind. new + pred Adj)"),
  AIC    = c(AIC(m_1), AIC(m_2), AIC(m_3), AIC(m_4)),
  BIC    = c(BIC(m_1), BIC(m_2), BIC(m_3), BIC(m_4)),
  R2     = c(summary(m_1)$r.squared, summary(m_2)$r.squared, summary(m_3)$r.squared, summary(m_4)$r.squared),
  adj_R2 = c(summary(m_1)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_2)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_3)$adj.r.squared, summary(m_4)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
    deltaAdj_R2 = adj_R2 - max(adj_R2)) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

summary(m_4)
vif(m_4)
```



# Relational mobility

```{r}
dat_wide <- df_g3_long %>%
  select(language, lexical_class, bias = mean, predicativeAdj, feature, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(individualism, flexibility, relmob, bias) %>% 
  mutate(
    individualism = as.numeric(scale(individualism)),
    flexibility   = as.numeric(scale(flexibility)),
    relmob    = as.numeric(scale(relmob)))

dat_wide %>% distinct(language) %>% nrow()   # 19 languages remained

# == Noun bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))
m_2 <- lm(bias ~ individualism + flexibility + relmob, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))
m_3 <- lm(bias ~ relmob, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))

tibble(model  = c("m_1 (ind. + flex.)", "m_2 (+ relmob)", "m_3 (relmob only)"),

summary(m_2)
vif(m_2)
summary(m_3)
```

# Cultural distance

```{r}
dat_wide <- df_g2_long %>%
  select(language, lexical_class, bias = mean, predicativeAdj, feature, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = value) %>%
  drop_na(distUS, distChina, bias) %>% 
  mutate(
    distUS    = as.numeric(scale(distUS)),
    distChina = as.numeric(scale(distChina)))

dat_wide %>% distinct(language) %>% nrow()   # 22 languages remained

# == Noun bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ distUS + distChina, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Nouns"))
summary(m_1)
vif(m_1)


# == Verb bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ distUS + distChina, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Verbs"))
summary(m_1)
vif(m_1)


# == Adjective bias
m_1 <- lm(bias ~ distUS + distChina, data = dat_wide %>% subset(lexical_class=="Adjectives"))
summary(m_1)
vif(m_1)
```
